changelog:
Closing the dashboard now closes DensAssistant.

Before, closing the browser tab left DensAssistant running unseen in the background. Now it shuts down about 20 seconds after you close the last dashboard tab. It stays running while a call is being recorded, while a meeting is still transcribing, or while another Densanon app is using it.

If you start it at login, it still runs in the background as before. Opening DensAssistant while it's already running now shows the dashboard instead of doing nothing.
